'''Squirrel''' is an organ harvester {{In|FOTV}}.<ref name="FalloutTV 4">{{fotv|1|4}}</ref>

==Background==
Squirrel, together with [[Huey]], manages the organ harvesting business at the [[Super Duper Mart (TV series)|Super Duper Mart]] with the help of their medical [[Mr. Handy]] robot [[Snip Snip]].<ref name="FalloutTV 4" /> They are under the protection of [[Sorrel Booker]]'s "[[Govermint]]."<ref name="FalloutTV 6">{{fotv|1|6}}</ref>

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Ghouls]]===
Within the Super Duper Mart, Squirrel sits on a couch beside Huey, watching a pre-War cartoon on their [[Television|TV]] while eating a cup of ramen. Soon, Snip Snip arrives with [[Lucy MacLean]] tied to a stretcher and announces to them that their latest "arrival" has arrived. For the most part, Squirrel ate his ramen as Huey talked to Snip about what to do with Lucy, and when they left, Huey mentioned to Squirrel how nice Snip Snip was.<ref name="FalloutTV 4" />

Afterward, Lucy returns to the two harvesters and demands that Squirrel and Huey raise their hands or else Snip Snip would get hurt.

The '''stabbed legionary''' is a member of a splinter faction of [[Caesar's Legion]] in the [[Mojave Wasteland]] in [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]].

==Background==
He served as a soldier as part of the late [[Caesar (TV series)|Caesar's]] camp and a subordinate of the [[Lacerta Legate]] during the [[Legion civil war]]. He was ultimately killed by the legate in order to hide the truth of Caesar's final intentions for the Legion.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Strip]]===
After the surge of violence in the [[Legion civil war]] caused by [[the Ghoul]], the legionary observes as the Lacerta Legate retrieves the skeletal remains of [[Caesar|Edward Sallow]] and drags it into a tent to which he follows. Seeing the legate pick up Caesar's final note, he asks the legate what the contents of the note are and who will become the Legion's leader. However, having discovered that Caesar wished for the Legion to die with him, the legate tells the legionary "Long live Caesar" and fatally stabs him in the abdomen to cover up the truth. Before he wakes, MacLean attaches one of the chips to the back of Winthrop's neck. After attaching the chip, he is taken to another room.
